known_limitations: AC-003 (Player Mana continuing to own only current mana/regen-delay state, not spell-local cooldown/charge/cast/placement/active-field state) has no dedicated automated test: it is a cross-system architecture/ownership invariant. A reflection-based field-name heuristic was considered but rejected as unreliable (e.g. the existing legitimate field postCastRegenDelay contains the substring 'cast', which would produce false positives). This criterion is better verified by code review of the diff (no such members were added) than by a brittle automated check.

PlayerManaUI has no public setters or test-facing seam for its private [SerializeField] fields (mana, fillImage, normalColor, deniedColor, deniedFlashDuration); tests use reflection to wire dependencies and read internal colors/duration. This is a standard workaround, not a production change, and required no escalation.

PlayerManaUI tests rely on real Unity Update()/Time.deltaTime (via yield return null / WaitForSeconds) since PlayerManaUI, unlike PlayerMana, exposes no deterministic Tick() hook for the flash timer. This introduces minor inherent timing sensitivity to editor frame time, mitigated with a 0.1s margin on the duration-based assertion.
Per Unity Testing Policy, these are static/source-level test additions only; no Unity Editor, Test Runner, or build was executed. No claim of pass/fail execution evidence is made.
